components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--binding, oklch(0.55 0.21 26)); color: oklch(0.99 0.005 30); height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 14px Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.55 0.21 26) 80%, white); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.21 26 / 55%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.html: Needs your decision 2 unsure Approved Demo data
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 3.6px; font: 500 12px Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-decision { background: oklch(0.55 0.21 26); color: #fff; } .ds-unsure { background: oklch(0.96 0.045 85); color: oklch(0.42 0.1 60); } .ds-settled { background: oklch(0.96 0.03 155); color: oklch(0.48 0.11 155); } .ds-dummy { border: 1px dashed oklch(0.9 0.008 60); color: oklch(0.47 0.012 50); }

components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 240px; padding: 16px; background: oklch(0.55 0.21 26); color: oklch(0.99 0.005 30); font-family: Roboto, 'Noto Sans Bengali', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', sans-serif; } .ds-mark { font-size: 21px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .22em; padding: 8px 12px 24px; } .ds-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 4.8px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-item small { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 400; opacity: .75; } .ds-item:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.38 0.15 24) 60%, transparent); } .ds-active { background: oklch(0.38 0.15 24); }

components.name: Decision Seal
components.description: Signature: stamped on a requisition once the HOD decides.
components.css: .ds-seal { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 112px; height: 112px; padding: 4px; border: 2px solid oklch(0.48 0.11 155); border-radius: 50%; color: oklch(0.48 0.11 155); transform: rotate(-8deg); font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-seal > div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-seal small { font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .15em; opacity: .8; } .ds-seal b { font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: .06em; }

components.name: Ledger Row with Thread
components.description: Signature: an open account tied by the crimson thread.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 8px 12px 0; border-top: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0.008 60); border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0.008 60); color: oklch(0.25 0.008 260); text-decoration: none; font: 14px Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-row:hover { background: oklch(0.985 0.003 60); } .ds-row small { color: oklch(0.47 0.012 50); } .ds-thread { position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: center; width: 16px; } .ds-thread::before { content: ''; width: 1px; background: oklch(0.55 0.21 26); } .ds-thread i { position: absolute; top: 50%; width: 8px; height: 8px; margin-top: -4px; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(0.55 0.21 26); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff; }

narrative.overview: The red cloth-bound ledger a Bengali trader opens every Poila Baisakh, rendered as working software. Vinayak's crimson is the binding: it wraps the navigation and marks the accounts the HOD still has to settle. The page inside is plain white stock ruled with one-pixel hairlines, and every figure sits in tabular columns.
keyCharacteristics: Crimson binding rail as navigation, with the white text wordmark on it. The red-on-transparent logo appears only on white.
Open accounts carry a crimson thread (a 1px cord with a knot) until the HOD signs them off.
Decisions stamp a circular seal. Nothing disappears; it is approved, rejected or sent back.
English first, with Bengali and Hindi as a quieter second line on navigation and statuses.
Light only. The HOD works under office light and in daylight on a phone.

rules.name: The Decision Rule
rules.body: Crimson means brand or "your decision now". A crimson element the HOD cannot act on, or that is not the brand, is a defect.

rules.name: The Honest Ink Rule
rules.body: Uncertainty is shown in turmeric and never hidden. Rejection reads as struck-through, never erased.

rules.name: The Column Rule
rules.body: Numbers are figures, not decoration: tabular-nums, right-aligned, unit beside them. A null shows as "—" or "Not provided", never as 0.

dos: Do lead every working page with what needs the HOD's decision.
Do show AI uncertainty, null values and clarification questions in turmeric, next to the value they concern.
Do label every simulated value (demo stock, demo vendor history, mocked endpoints) with the dashed dummy badge or the demo banner.
Do set every number in tabular figures with its unit.
Do require a note on every approve, reject or clarify decision.
donts: Don't use crimson for decoration, charts or emphasis that isn't a decision.
Don't add kickers or eyebrows above headings.
Don't add thick coloured side stripes. The thread is the only left-edge mark, and it is 1px.
Don't auto-select, auto-approve or pre-tick any decision. The human decides.
Don't render the red logo on a crimson surface. Use the white text wordmark there.
Don't show a missing quantity as 0 or guess a unit.
